---
title: "DuckDB, driven by state"
---

`@jr200-labs/xstate-duckdb` manages a browser DuckDB database with XState v5 actors. Configure a database, run SQL, coordinate transactions, and load versioned tables through typed events.

[Get started](getting-started.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Try the live demo](demo.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## What it provides

- A database lifecycle machine with observable connection and transaction states.
- Queries returning Arrow tables, arrays, maps, or scalar values.
- A table catalog with Arrow IPC loading, version retention, and subscriptions.
- Load metrics, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and SQL helpers for optimistic projections.

## How it fits together

Your application sends events to `duckdbMachine`. The root actor manages the database and transactions; its `dbCatalog` child manages table definitions, queued loads, versions, and subscriptions. DuckDB-Wasm executes SQL in a browser worker.

The library does not provide a database server or durable synchronization. The demo uses an in-memory database that is recreated when the page reloads. DuckDB worker and WASM assets are fetched from jsDelivr during connection.

The documentation and demo are built from the same repository revision. See the [API reference](reference.qmd) for supported events and the [live demo](demo.qmd) to watch state transitions.
